info.name: tenantfabric - inference, tools, MCP & memory
info.description: End-to-end requests for a tenantfabric gateway. Import together with tenantfabric.postman_environment.json. Run folders in order; MCP folders store Mcp-Session-Id from initialize.

item.name: 0. Smoke & auth
item.description: Reachability and authentication. Set clientKey in the environment (alpha's key by default).

item.name: 1. Inference
item.description: Inference through model aliases. {{model}} is a model your team may use, {{deniedModel}} one it may not.

exec: pm.test('Has a choice with content', () => pm.expect(j.choices && j.choices[0].message.content).to.be.a('string'));

item.name: 2. Tool calling
item.description: OpenAI function calling. The demo model calls tools only some of the time: point chat-general at a real model for agent work.

exec: pm.test('Model returned a tool_call (small demo models do this unreliably)', () => pm.expect(tc, JSON.stringify(msg)).to.be.ok);
